title: Create&Magic-Vanilla+
description: A modpack designed to enhance the vanilla gameplay, as well as add the Create mod, as well as more magic and fantasy elements to explore.
body: A modpack that goes for a vanilla+ style fo minecraft, adding lots of quality of life cahnges, furniture and building blocks, and enhanced features. Includes the Create mod with several addons. Also has added magic casting mods, with added fantasy elements for exploration.
